raw_description: We work with some of the biggest names in the Media & Entertainment Industry. Do you have what it takes? Travel Beyond Limits and audition today! Senior Travel Consultant- Publicity Entertainment (Remote) Full time, Singapore As a Senior Entertainment Travel Consultant, you will confidently offer expert guidance and be keen to share your knowledge. You will want to assist our clients to perfect their travel plans. You will be calm and reassuring and no challenge will be too much trouble. You will be able to offer hints and suggestions and will enjoy making recommendations. This could be for a great place to stay, the best seat onboard, the latest special offers, or just ways to make their journey run more smoothly. And of course, you'll give our clients all of the necessary data to allow them freedom and responsibility to make informed decisions wherever possible and immerse yourself in clients business environment. As a Senior Travel Consultant - Publicity Entertainment, you will Accurately and efficiently handle incoming travel requests via multiple channels e.g., phone, emails. Travel could be for A-listers, VIPs, Talent, Press, and groups. Providecreative solutions to ensure the publicists requirements are met Being aware of their budgets and offering the best solutions possible Understandthe needs of Publicists and travelers, appropriately guiding them to the best solutions Handleamendments, cancellations, and schedule changes, including the recalculations of domestic and international airfares Handleaccommodation, meet & greets, chauffeured cars, lounges, and other VIP services Delivergreat customer service each and every time, showing your enthusiasm for working with the clients UpdateTravel Manifests and travel logs Ensureaccuracy in itineraries, and back-office invoicing and billing Keepup to date with the changing nature of travel resulting from the pandemic Providevisa and country entry restriction guidance Workwith colleagues in different regions to provide a successful global follow the sun operation About you Previous entertainment travel experience or VIP travel is essential A strong working knowledge of Sabre GDS and good fares and ticketing expertise Good worldwide geography and keen attention to detail Proven ability to handle multiple priorities simultaneously, able to adapt to change Ability to work flexible hours Ability to work independently, exercising discretion and judgement Proven excellent customer service provision and problem resolution skills Ability to work under pressure Adaptable to aspects of the client culture Ability to work with international teams to serve a common goal Experience with handling small or large groups would be beneficial About BCD Media & Entertainment We are the Media & Entertainment division of BCD Travel, one of the world's largest and most admired travel management companies.Leading artists, sporting teams, labels, media, and production companies have trusted us with their travel for over 40 years.We handle anything from managing travel for TV & Film productions, making sure that the artists and their entourage arrive on the red carpet on time, to transporting a football team internationally to a cup final at a moment's notice! What we offer you At BCD Travel, we work with highly motivated and passionate people. We value open communication, collaboration, and a flexible work-life balance. We offer unique, often global, experiences that empower you to develop and grow within the organization. Sustainability and helping others is also high on our list. We make a difference through charitable activities in our communities across the globe. About us BCD Travel helps companies travel smart and achieve more. We drive program adoption, cost savings and talent retention through digital experiences that simplify business travel. Our 15,000+ dedicated team members service clients in 170+ countries as we shape a sustainable future for business travel. BCD's leading meetings and events management and global consultancy services complete our comprehensive suite of solutions for all aspects of corporate travel. In 2024, BCD achieved US$22.9 billion in sales. For more information, visit www.bcdtravel.com. Get to know us by reading our blog and checking out our social media: https://www.bcdtravel.com/blog/ https://www.linkedin.com/company/bcd-travel/ https://www.instagram.com/bcdtravel/ https://www.facebook.com/bcdtravel/ You'll be offered Flexible working hours and work-from-home or remote opportunities Opportunities to grow your skillset and career Generous vacation days so you can rest and recharge A compensation package that feels fair to you, including mental, physical, and financial wellbeing tools Travel industry professional perks and discounts An inclusive work environment where diversity is celebrated Ready to join the journey? Apply now! We're dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. If you're excited about a role, but your experience doesn't align perfectly, we still encourage you to apply. We are committed to providing reasonable and necessary accommodations to ensure all employees can perform their roles effectively. For accommodation requests or further information, contact our Talent Acquisition department at careers@bcdtravel.com. #LI-Remote #LI-FB1
